senderType.description: How the SMS is sent. Determines which sender field is required: PHONE_NUMBER requires phoneNumber, ALPHANUMERIC requires alphanumericSender, MESSAGE_SERVICE requires messageServiceSid. Omit the field to keep the current value.

phoneNumber.description: Sending phone number. Required when senderType is PHONE_NUMBER; normalized to E.164 by the SMS service. Take the value from get_sms_phone_numbers or GET /api/sms/phone-numbers; a number outside that list fails with 422. Omit the field to keep the current value; send null to clear it.

alphanumericSender.description: Alphanumeric sender name. Required when senderType is ALPHANUMERIC. Letters, digits and spaces only, at least one letter, never digits only. Omit the field to keep the current value; send null to clear it.

messageServiceSid.description: Twilio message service SID. Required when senderType is MESSAGE_SERVICE. Take the value from get_sms_message_services or GET /api/sms/message-services; a SID outside that list fails with 422. Omit the field to keep the current value; send null to clear it.
